preliminary_candidate_decisions.decision: Function-valued deterministic witness elimination in composition — eligible, narrowly.
preliminary_candidate_decisions.reason: `ComposeRepresentation.Rep.compose` and `DirectComposition.GraphRep.composeDirect` end with an existential function `a` constrained pointwise to the deterministic composed vector. After the previous Fin-block and assignment APIs have done their work, an extensional equality substitution remains. No prior file mentions `funext_iff` or `exists_eq_right`; no prior candidate changes these two correctness tails. Closest prior idea is m's Boolean certificate consumption, but that is a fixed finite Boolean/slack certificate. The new claim should be confined to eliminating the *function-valued deterministic intermediate*, not generic existential simplification.

preliminary_candidate_decisions.reason: No prior proposal text/code/patch mentions `row_zero_of_helix`, `HelicalQuotient`, `helix`, or `sub_int_mul_eq`. The nearby u/v interval proof concerns guarded propagation on a bounded interval, and i/l finite inverse invariance concerns finite dynamics. Neither produces the one-period function `s ↦ T(x+w*s,t-s)`. Packet o explicitly declines a generic additive-quotient framework; the proposed local application of `Function.Periodic` requires none.

`ThirteenCarrierSoundness` appears in f only as an avoidable import in dependency restructuring. Neither its `auxiliary_estimates` nor `transport_nonneg`, nor an `abs_le_self_sq`/`abs_le_sq` simplification, appears in the proposal corpus. Common negative-norm obstructions in q concern other exact targets and a different mechanism.
